title: Section 20 — Other suits to be instituted where defendants reside or cause of action arises — CPC 1908

content.heading: Other suits to be instituted where defendants reside or cause of action arises
content.text: Subject to the limitations aforesaid, every suit shall be instituted in a Court within the local limits of whose jurisdiction the defendant or each of the defendants actually and voluntarily resides, or carries on business, or personally works for gain; or any of the defendants does so and the others acquiesce or the Court grants leave; or the cause of action, wholly or in part, arises. Read the official explanations.
